description: Kinkerstraat 1888-1897 shop rows (18-4, 186-202, 206-210, 296-300, 338-340): red-brown brick, 2 axes per ~4 m module, segmental-arched sash windows with white blocked arch rings (springer blocks, two voussoirs, keystone), a white sill course and a white impost-block course on every upper storey, heavy cream stucco cornice with consoles; crowns: one pediment dormer with scrolled sides per module, none, a stepped corner gable, a flat-topped tower-dormer; every ground floor its own shop

pediment-dormer.note: one pedimented dormer with scrolled cheeks per module, centred, standing behind the cornice (2-30 pands 6-14; 206-242 pands 14-15) (#98: white painted bodies, dormerBody stone; a trim-slot body exported as a frame sunk in the low front attic and failed the opening-outside audit)

step-gable.note: Kinkerstraat 2 (163325): a dark brick stepped gable over the whole front, 2 steps a side, one attic window; top ~2.6 m over the cornice line on the strip

tower.note: 186-202 (157310, 161134): a brick dormer-tower with an arched light over both axes

roof.evidence: strips 2024-11-29/2024-12-11: over the cornice only the dormers stand against the sky, no roof face shows; PDOK orthophoto 2024: flat roofs (terraces, bitumen) behind a ~1 m front slope on Kinkerstraat 1A-5, 4-20, 55-63; a low attic behind the cornice instead of the 70 degree attic storey

rhythm.identicalBays: upper storeys: 2 equal axes, no balconies
rhythm.symmetry: symmetric about the module centre above the shop
rhythm.roofline: heavy cream stucco cornice with consoles and a frieze; one pediment dormer per module
schemaLimits: the dark rubbed-brick ring between the white springers is not drawn (no band brick measured; the springers style draws no ring)
the springers are square slabs; the photo's are wedge-shaped, rising toward the arch (a V over each pier)
pediment dormer cheeks are plain (no scrolls); the frieze consoles and panels are a plain frieze
iron wall anchors between the windows (in the gap between two springers) are not drawn

Bands: bands painted (Oud-West 1900 lane, merged 2026-10-14) on the sill and transom lines, 0.10 and 0.12 m: the white sill course and the upper course measured as band rows 0.10-0.13 m tall on 162482 and 236814 (evidence above). The planned 0.04 / 0.05 m sill + head bands were 2 px at 40 px/m and put the upper line on the arch springing, ~0.75 m above the photo course.

White courses and heads (kit lane 2026-10-14): archRing style springers (springerSize [0.32, 0.28]: the white impost blocks of 162482 at 12.75-13.05 m, 0.30-0.35 m long from each jamb, 0.09 m apart over the pier); headLines 0.94 / 0.856 / 0.793 and windowHeights 0.635 / 0.651 / 0.655 put the arch crowns at the springer rows (7.15, 9.97, 12.75 m + the 0.08 m rise) and the sills on the sill courses (5.2, 8.05, 10.9 m) of 162482 and 236814 on the kit's 15.19 m storeys [4.22, 3.20, 3.07, 2.95]; the thin continuous course is the transom band at 0.63 of the window (6.43 / 9.28 / 12.11 m measured), 0.08 m; stone = paint from palette-from-strip.ts (band-to-frame luma ratio x the drawn frame): median #eae7dc of the 7 pands with band rows (ratios 1.008-1.115), dark-brown #dddad0 (163325, accent = frame), stoneMaterial painted so the look keeps it white.
